mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with a temperature of 40 degrees near Verona Area High School. You can also catch the ISS passing overhead tonight, rising in the northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the southeast near Oregon, reaching almost directly overhead.
Winter parking rules are in effect starting November 20, requiring alternate-side parking between 1 AM and 6 AM, and the Verona Senior Center will be closed for Thanksgiving on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do with Main Street Trick-Or-Treat happening today, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow, and Yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2.
On October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after locating him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to satisfy your sweet tooth.
